g.text: Connecting active well bit depth to historical offset hazards across geological formation transitions.
Interval: 2200m – 3100m MD · Moderate drag zones recorded
FORMATION F3 · FRACTURED LIMESTONE & POROUS SANDSTONE (TARGET RESERVOIR)
Interval: 3100m – 4000m MD · High risk of severe lost circulation, stick-slip & differential sticking
